option.name: --add-dir
tip: Additional directories to allow tool access to.

option.name: --agent
tip: Agent for the current session. Overrides the 'agent' setting.

option.name: --agents
tip: JSON object defining custom agents.

option.name: --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions
tip: Enable bypassing all permission checks as an option.

option.name: --allowed-tools
tip: Comma or space-separated list of tool names to allow.

option.name: --append-system-prompt
tip: Append a system prompt to the default system prompt.

option.name: --bare
tip: Minimal mode: skip hooks, LSP, plugin sync, attribution, auto-memory, background prefetches, keychain reads, and CLAUDE.md auto-discovery.

option.name: --betas
tip: Beta headers to include in API requests (API key users only).

option.name: --chrome
tip: Enable Claude in Chrome integration.

option.name: --continue
tip: Continue the most recent conversation in the current directory.

option.name: --dangerously-skip-permissions
tip: Bypass all permission checks. Recommended only for sandboxes with no internet access.

option.name: --debug
tip: Enable debug mode with optional category filtering.

option.name: --debug-file
tip: Write debug logs to a specific file path (implicitly enables debug mode).

option.name: --disable-slash-commands
tip: Disable all skills.

option.name: --disallowed-tools
tip: Comma or space-separated list of tool names to deny.

option.name: --effort
tip: Effort level for the current session.

option.name: --fallback-model
tip: Enable automatic fallback to specified model when default model is overloaded.

option.name: --file
tip: File resources to download at startup. Format: file_id:relative_path.

option.name: --fork-session
tip: When resuming, branch the conversation into a new session ID.

option.name: --from-pr
tip: Resume a session linked to a PR by PR number/URL, or open interactive picker.

option.name: --heartbeat
tip: Emit a headless liveness heartbeat while output is quiet (only works with --print).

option.name: --ide
tip: Automatically connect to IDE on startup if exactly one valid IDE is available.

option.name: --include-hook-events
tip: Include all hook lifecycle events in the output stream (only works with --output-format=stream-json).

option.name: --include-partial-messages
tip: Include partial message chunks as they arrive (only works with --print and --output-format=stream-json).

option.name: --input-format
tip: Input format (only works with --print): "text" (default), or "stream-json".

option.name: --json-schema
tip: JSON Schema for structured output validation.

option.name: --max-budget-usd
tip: Maximum dollar amount to spend on API calls (only works with --print).

option.name: --max-turns
tip: Maximum number of agentic turns per prompt.

option.name: --mcp-config
tip: Load MCP servers from JSON files or strings (space-separated).

option.name: --mcp-debug
tip: Enable MCP debug mode (shows MCP server errors). Deprecated: Use --debug instead.

option.name: --model
tip: Model for the current session. Provide an alias (e.g. 'sonnet' or 'opus') or a full model name.

option.name: --name
tip: Set a display name for this session.

option.name: --no-chrome
tip: Disable Claude in Chrome integration.

option.name: --no-session-persistence
tip: Disable session persistence - sessions will not be saved to disk and cannot be resumed.

option.name: --output-format
tip: Output format (only works with --print): "text", "json", or "stream-json".

option.name: --permission-mode
tip: Permission mode to use for the session.

option.name: --plugin-dir
tip: Load plugins from a directory for this session only (repeatable).

option.name: --print
tip: Print response and exit (useful for pipes).

option.name: --prompt-suggestions
tip: Enable prompt suggestions. In print/SDK mode, emits a prompt_suggestion message after each turn.

option.name: --provider
tip: AI provider to use (anthropic, openai, gemini, github, bedrock, vertex, ollama).

option.name: --provider-env-file
tip: Load provider environment variables from a file before validation (repeatable).

option.name: --replay-user-messages
tip: Re-emit user messages from stdin back on stdout for acknowledgment (only works with --input-format=stream-json and --output-format=stream-json).

option.name: --resume
tip: Resume a conversation by session ID, or open interactive picker.

option.name: --session-id
tip: Use a specific session ID for the conversation.

option.name: --setting-sources
tip: Comma-separated list of setting sources to load (user, project, local).

option.name: --settings
tip: Path to a settings JSON file or a JSON string to load additional settings from.

option.name: --strict-mcp-config
tip: Only use MCP servers from --mcp-config, ignoring all other MCP configurations.

option.name: --system-prompt
tip: System prompt to use for the session.

option.name: --system-prompt-snapshot
tip: Record the system prompt once per conversation and reuse it verbatim.

option.name: --tmux
tip: Create a tmux session for the worktree (requires --worktree).

option.name: --tools
tip: Specify the list of available tools from the built-in set.

option.name: --version
tip: Output the version number.

option.name: --worktree
tip: Create a new git worktree for this session (optionally specify a name).

global_option.name: --help
tip: Display help for command.
